name: Fashion doll
definition: a styled doll with a slim adult-like or teen body, made to be dressed and posed.

name: Baby doll
definition: a doll made to look like an infant or toddler, for nurturing play.

name: Ball-jointed doll
definition: a doll whose limbs and torso are joined by ball joints on elastic or string, made for posing and customising.

name: Bisque or porcelain doll
definition: a doll with head and body cast as one in porcelain or bisque.

name: Articulated action figure
definition: a figure with many joints made to be posed and played with or displayed in varied poses.

name: Static pre-posed figure
definition: a figure fixed in one pose, in any scale including statue scale, sold finished or as an unpainted kit to assemble and paint; includes prize figures and loose miniatures sold outside a game-system box.

name: Chibi or super-deformed figure
definition: a figure with an oversized head and small body, usually with swappable faces or parts.

name: Designer or art-toy figure
definition: a figure made as a collectible art object, often vinyl, from a designer's or brand's own character, often blind-packed.

name: Toy animal or toy soldier figure
definition: a small moulded figure of an animal or soldier made for pretend play.

name: Bobblehead
definition: a figure with a head on a spring or pin so that it nods.

name: Plush toy
definition: a stuffed fabric toy; includes plush pendants with clip or chain and figures with a stuffed fabric body.

name: Puppet
definition: a figure worked by the hand, rods or strings to act out play.

name: Dolls' house
definition: a house or building made at doll scale to be furnished and played in.

name: Figure-and-scene playset
definition: small figures sold with a scene, building or set of accessories for pretend play.

name: Interlocking brick set
definition: a set of plastic bricks or blocks that clip together by studs or tubes.

name: Metal construction set
definition: a set of perforated metal strips and plates joined by nuts and bolts.

name: Wooden construction set
definition: a set of wooden blocks, rods or boards for building.

name: Marble-run construction set
definition: a set of parts that join into a track or tower for rolling balls.

name: Toy robot
definition: a robot made as a toy for play.

name: Coding toy
definition: a toy made for play that teaches or plays programming by commands.

name: Assembly scale model
definition: a model of a vehicle or machine in plastic, resin or card, sold as a kit to assemble or pre-built.

name: Die-cast scale model
definition: a metal model of a vehicle at any scale, from 1:64 pocket cars to 1:18 display models.

name: Model locomotive
definition: a powered model railway engine.

name: Model rolling stock
definition: an unpowered model railway wagon, coach or carriage.

name: Model railway track
definition: rails and points for a model railway.

name: Model railway train set
definition: a starter set of locomotive, stock and track sold together.

name: Model railway scenery kit
definition: buildings, scenery or lineside accessories for a model railway.

name: Push-along or pull-back toy vehicle
definition: a plastic or wooden vehicle the child pushes or that runs by pull-back or friction.

name: Wooden toy railway
definition: a wooden toy train with wooden track.

name: Radio-controlled vehicle
definition: a car, boat, aircraft or hobby drone controlled by radio, sold as an RC toy or hobby model; includes combustion-engined hobby cars and camera-less toy drones.

name: Slot-car racing set
definition: a toy car racing set with grooved track and hand controllers.

name: Ride-on car
definition: a child-sized car pushed, pedalled or powered, that the child sits in.

name: Balance bike
definition: a child's bike without pedals, pushed along with the feet.

name: Children's tricycle
definition: a three-wheeled pedalled cycle for a young child.

name: Boxed board game
definition: a published game on a board or in a box with its own pieces.

name: Chess set
definition: a board and pieces for chess.

name: Go set
definition: a board and stones for go.

name: Shogi set
definition: a board and pieces for shogi.

name: Backgammon set
definition: a board with checkers and dice for backgammon.

name: Reversi set
definition: a board and two-sided discs for reversi (Othello is a named form).

name: Draughts set
definition: a board and discs for draughts (checkers).

name: Standard playing-card deck
definition: a deck of regional-pattern playing cards (French-suited, German-suited, tarock and similar), sold for card play; size is an attribute.

name: Proprietary card game
definition: a published card game with its own special cards.

name: Flower-card deck
definition: a 48-card Japanese or Korean flower-card deck (hanafuda).

name: Domino set
definition: a set of domino tiles.

name: Mahjong tile set
definition: a set of mahjong tiles.

name: Proprietary tile game
definition: a published game played with its own tiles.

name: Proprietary dice game
definition: a published game played mainly with its own dice.

name: Dice set
definition: a set of polyhedral or ordinary dice sold as a set.

name: Trading-card-game sealed product
definition: a sealed pack, box, tin or ready-made deck of a trading card game.

name: Trading-card-game single card
definition: a single card of a trading card game, as a kind (a particular card is an individual item and out).

name: Miniatures-game starter set
definition: a box with miniatures, rules and accessories to start a miniatures game.

name: Miniatures-game army or unit box
definition: a box of miniatures making up a unit or army for a miniatures game.

name: Table football
definition: a table with rods of players for a game of football.

name: Air hockey table
definition: a table with an air cushion for a puck game.

name: Pinball machine
definition: a coin-operated or home machine with flippers and a ball.

name: Claw crane, redemption game or other coin-operated game without a screen.
Carrom board
definition: a square board with pockets, played by flicking discs.

name: Crokinole board
definition: a round board with a central hole, played by flicking discs.

name: Dexterity game
definition: a game of physical skill with its own pieces (stacking, balancing, flicking).

name: Poker chip set
definition: chips sold as a set for poker or casino play.

name: Roulette wheel
definition: a roulette wheel for casino or home play.

name: Gaming table
definition: a table made for poker, blackjack, craps or baccarat.

name: Card shoe or shuffler
definition: a dealing shoe or card shuffler.

name: Prize wheel
definition: a spinning wheel for prizes or chance.

name: Raffle drum
definition: a rotating drum for drawing raffle tickets.

name: Bingo set
definition: bingo cards, balls, a cage or a caller sold for bingo.

name: Slot machine
definition: a casino or skill-stop slot machine, whatever display it uses.

name: Jigsaw puzzle
definition: a flat picture cut into interlocking pieces.

name: Three-dimensional jigsaw puzzle
definition: interlocking pieces that assemble into a solid shape.

name: Mechanical puzzle
definition: a puzzle solved by manipulating its parts, including twisty, interlocking and disentanglement puzzles and puzzle boxes.

name: Play kitchen
definition: a child's kitchen with hob, oven or sink for pretend cooking.

name: Toy shop or tool set
definition: a child's play shop, tool bench, tool set or similar pretend-work set, including play money sold for pretend play and a garden tool set that cannot do the job.

name: Toy dress-up accessory
definition: a toy crown, wand, wings or similar piece made as a toy.

name: Play make-up set
definition: make-up made as a toy.

name: Toy weapon
definition: a foam dart blaster, water blaster, toy gun, play sword or foam replica, a toy slingshot or blowgun made as a toy.

name: Toy musical instrument
definition: an instrument made as a toy.

name: Musical pull-toy
definition: a toy that plays a tune when pulled or pushed.

name: Rattle
definition: a handheld toy that rattles, for an infant.

name: Stacking toy
definition: rings, cups or blocks that stack.

name: Shape sorter
definition: a toy with shaped holes and matching pieces.

name: Activity play mat
definition: a mat with toys or a gym for floor play.

name: Bath toy
definition: a toy made to float or splash in the bath.

name: Spinning top
definition: a top spun by hand, string or launcher, including battle tops.

name: Yo-yo
definition: a yo-yo.

name: Fidget toy
definition: a small handheld toy for fidgeting.

name: Kite
definition: a kite made as a toy.

name: Toy flying disc
definition: a disc thrown as a toy.

name: Toy ball
definition: a ball made as a toy.

name: Bubble toy
definition: a bubble-blowing toy.

name: Water play toy
definition: a pool, beach or water toy.

name: Piñata
definition: a hollow figure filled with sweets, broken at a party.

name: Magic set
definition: a set of tricks and props for conjuring.

name: Mechanical bank
definition: a money bank with a mechanical action.

name: Toy light
definition: a torch or nightlight shaped as a toy.

name: Swing set
definition: a frame with swing seats.

name: Swing seat
definition: a swing seat or hanging seat sold alone, without a frame.

name: Slide or climbing frame
definition: a slide or climbing structure for children.

name: Playhouse
definition: a rigid play house or treehouse for children.

name: Garden or play trampoline
definition: a trampoline for play.

name: Paddling pool
definition: a shallow pool made for play.

name: Inflatable activity toy
definition: an inflatable play structure or bouncer.

name: Doll clothes and shoes
definition: clothes or shoes made for dolls.

name: Dolls' pram
definition: a pram or pushchair for dolls.

name: Card sleeve
definition: a protective sleeve for individual playing or trading cards.

name: Deck box
definition: a box made to hold a deck of cards.

name: Poker-chip case
definition: a case made to hold poker chips.

name: Casino table layout
definition: a printed cloth layout for a casino game table.

name: Model-railway controller
definition: a hand or digital controller for a model railway.

name: Replacement game pieces and game accessories
definition: spare or add-on pieces made for a game, including game money sold for one game.
